properties.description:
Three tests in crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/an_ephemeral_design_says_so_in_its_handshake.rs, plus the four refusals exercised by hand.

⭐ THE SECOND TEST IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS: every HTTP session is served by `share()` rather than by the original service, so a warning that did not propagate would be seen by nobody who could act on it.

⚠️ AND THE THIRD IS THE NEGATIVE CASE. A warning that fires on ordinary designs becomes noise readers learn to skip, and then it is not there when it is true.
properties.findings:
PASSING 2026-09-13. Three tests green: the handshake carries the ephemeral warning and it comes FIRST; the warning survives share() into a per-session service; a design on disk is NOT labelled ephemeral.

The four refusals were exercised by hand against the built binary, each exiting 1 with its own message: --ephemeral with --graph-path, with --registry-root, with --shared, and with --serve-shared. Also confirmed by hand that an --ephemeral run writes nothing to disk and creates no stray store.
properties.name: An ephemeral design warns in its handshake, the warning survives into a session, and a persistent design is not labelled
